comprehensive_coverage.rationale: All parts of the competency are covered. The dataset includes examples for finding "the place value of a digit in a 2-digit number" (seed 43, 46, 72, 601), calculating "the value of a digit" (seed 44, 45, 50, 500, 600, 602), and finding "the digit of a number, given its place value" (seed 42, 501, 502).
